assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained rough provisional constraints inferred from the public announcement and must not be treated as official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics, diagrams, land-use partitions, roads, public-space proposals and phasing areas are design discussion evidence only and must be regenerated when official GIS/CAD files become available.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson with cleared official files, then regenerate all derived geometry, metrics, figures, HTML and PDFs.

assumptions.statement: Ownership, existing buildings, road redlines, rail interfaces, municipal utilities, flood-control, heritage, fire and accessibility conditions are not fully supplied in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish logic, building intensity, facility standards and implementation sequence remain reference suggestions rather than approvals or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use public or cleared aggregate data, data minimization, explainability, opt-out where applicable and human review; no individual profiling or mandatory vendor is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Any future pilot must pass privacy, security, accessibility, procurement, public-participation and professional review gates before operation.
